dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Visible 'O' and 'C' shaped rings with soft, irregular light-colored perimeters. A prominent closed loop in the mid-section exhibits a sharp gradient transition from the dark surrounding pelage to a lighter interior, with edge thickness varying between 2-8 pixels.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of solid, high-intensity light-grey pixel clusters concentrated primarily along the lower lateral flank. These clusters are asymmetrical and lack the internal darker core typical of the macro-annuli.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Spatial arrangement of the four most prominent ring centroids forms an irregular quadrilateral across the dorsal-lateral plane, with the most defined 'O' structure serving as a central anchor point.
